[h1]Reseña de Thorne - Son of Slaves (Ep.2): El Héroe Que Nadie Pidió, Pero Que Todos Merecemos[/h1]

[h2]Resumen[/h2]
¿Te encanta la acción y las aventuras que se toman tan en serio que terminan siendo graciosas? ¡Perfecto! \Thorne - Son of Slaves (Ep. 2)\ es la continuación de esa epopeya donde intentarás liberar esclavos con la carga dramática de un telefilme de domingo por la tarde. Pese a sus momentos \facepalm\, el título te mantendrá pegado porque, al final, todos queremos saber si Thorne finalmente conseguirá encontrar su camisa y dejar de causar tanto revuelo.

[h2]Aspectos importantes e interesantes[/h2]
- **Combate**: Al igual que su antecesor, el combate intenta ser táctico pero a veces sientes que estás peleando contra el contrincante y contra los controles.
- **Gráficos**: Mira, no esperes triple A. Sin embargo, los colores y la atmósfera hacen un buen trabajo en mantenernos en un mundo pseudo-medieval sin WiFi.
- **Historia**: Agárrate que hay curvas. Si te gustó la primera parte, aquí hay más enredos y giros que en una telenovela turca.

[h2]Aspectos por mejorar[/h2]
- **Voces**: Al parecer, el presupuesto de voz fue el mismo que se usa para una cena familiar en un fast food. Un poquitín más de emoción no le haría mal a nadie.
- **IA**: Los enemigos a veces tienen menos sentido de supervivencia que un lemming en un acantilado. Podrían mejorar esta parte para que el reto realmente se sienta.
- **Diversidad de enemigos**: Luchar contra el mismo tipo de malos numeritos veces puede volverse un poco monótono, ¿no?

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

《Thorne - Son of Slaves (Ep.2)》作为《Thorne》系列的续作，发布后吸引了不少玩家的关注。然而在我亲自体验过后，却发现这款游戏在剧情和游戏体验方面存在着诸多令人失望之处。

首先游戏的剧情设计显得平淡无奇。虽然游戏试图通过讲述Thorne作为奴隶之子的故事来展现一个波澜壮阔的史诗世界，但整体剧情缺乏足够的吸引力和深度。角色的塑造也相对单薄，玩家很难对他们产生足够的情感共鸣。同时游戏的剧情推进也显得缓慢而拖沓，让人难以保持对故事的兴趣。

其次游戏的操作体验并不理想。角色的移动和战斗反应不够流畅，导致玩家在关键时刻难以准确执行操作。游戏的战斗系统也缺乏足够的深度和策略性，使得战斗过程变得单调乏味。此外游戏的界面设计也不够友好，一些功能按钮的位置和布局不够合理，给玩家带来了不必要的困扰。

在画面和音效方面，游戏的表现也平平无奇。虽然游戏试图通过精美的画面和音效来营造出一个沉浸式的游戏体验，但实际效果却不尽如人意。画面的细节处理不够精细，色彩渲染也显得单调，无法给玩家带来良好的视觉享受。音效方面，游戏缺乏具有特色的音效设计，使得整个游戏过程显得平淡无奇。

此外游戏还存在一些技术性问题。例如我在游玩过程中遇到了多次卡顿和加载缓慢的情况，这不仅影响了游戏的流畅度，也极大地降低了我的游戏体验。

综上所述，在剧情设计、操作体验、画面音效以及技术性问题等方面都存在着诸多令人失望之处。虽然它试图为玩家带来一个沉浸式的史诗世界体验，但最终却未能实现这一目标。如果你对这款游戏抱有期待，我建议你在选择之前要三思而后行。

[h1]Not ready for the commercial market.[/h1]

[b]Pros[/b]
[list]
    [*]Decent mapping (I feel like the mapping in the first installation was actually better)
    [*]You can import your previous save (items, stat points, etc.)
[/list]
[b]Cons[/b]
[list]
    [*]Passability errors galore - you'll often find yourself stuck in a wall or barrel.
    [*]Spelling/grammatical errors in almost every line of dialogue. (I shouldn't be surprised because it was the same with the first)
    [*]So much junky filler - it honestly feels like the developer lost inspiration and just threw together a bunch of quests that feel like they have no actual impact on the story or world.
    [*]The Blood Swamp area is horribly bugged - the people I was supposed to escort would get stuck in/behind rocks and I couldn't progress the quest.
[/list]

I mean, you can try to pick it up when it's on sale - but I'd say this one needed a lot more polish before it was ready to be released commercially.

[b]Thorne - Son of Slaves[/b] é a continuação de Thorn Death Merchants e mantém as mesmas carecterísticas de seu antecessor. É um jogo que de simples, só tem os gráficos. A história é muito bem elaborada, os diálogos são muito bem escritos e com um belo toque de humor. Não falta ação no jogo e apesar de você utilizar somente alguns botões para realizar os comandos, você precisa de habilidade para derrotar os inimigos que aparecem em seu caminho. O jogo cria uma atmosfera muito legal e é bem envolvente, a trilha sonora é outro ponto positivo! 

Estou ansioso pela continuação e recomendo demais o jogo para aqueles que gostam de boas histórias misturadas com um toque de ação.
